risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Management names competition explicitly under 'Opportunities, Threats, Risk and Concerns' as a cause of concern hampering growth of the generic formulations market, and again in the Cautionary Statement as a factor that would make differences to the Company's operations.
- Flagged in the MD&A as a structural concern for the domestic generics market; poor perceived quality of Indian generics constrains category growth for all participants, including the Company's core generic formulations business.
- Explicitly listed by management as hampering growth of the generic formulations market. It matters directly for the Company, whose generics reach the market through dispensing doctors, nursing homes and hospitals and whose growth lever this year was appointing new distributors to widen geographical coverage.
- Management attributes the year's lower growth in the generic business and the lower demand for its liquid injectables to lower prevalence of acute diseases in the country during the financial year — a swing factor that hit two of the three product lines at once.
- Depreciation, finance cost and other overheads of the facility at GIDC, Naroda, Ahmedabad — commercialised only in the later part of FY2020-21 — impacted profitability in the year under report, and the improvement management expects depends on a product development, submission and dossier registration cycle it itself describes as lengthy and time consuming.
- Several product dossiers filed in earlier years remain under registration in ROW markets and eye drop supply to Eurasia has only just begun; approvals sit with regulatory authorities outside the Company's control, so the export ramp has no reliable timing.
- The Cautionary Statement enumerates competition, price realisation, changes in government policies and regulations, tax regimes and economic development within India as factors that could make actual results differ materially — a pharma-pricing and policy exposure concentrated entirely in one country.
- The standalone business made a loss for the year while consolidated results are carried by Resonance Specialties Ltd., which the Company consolidates on the basis of defacto control with a 45.48% shareholding rather than a majority stake; a large share of consolidated profit is attributable to non-controlling interest, and the control basis is itself contingent.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
